title: Outbox e-mail status (notifications.status), as the code uses it
caption: src/notifications/outbox.repository.ts: a claim is a lease on next_attempt_at, not a status, so 'sending' is never written; 'delivered' and 'bounced' exist in the CHECK list but no code sets them (no bounce webhooks in the MVP). secret_payload_ciphertext is purged when a row leaves pending.

states.label: pending
states.detail: Inserted in the business transaction (`dedupe_key` unique); due when `next_attempt_at` ≤ now. A worker's lease moves `next_attempt_at` 5 minutes ahead.

states.label: sent
states.detail: Handed to SMTP (`sent_at`, `provider_message_id`, Message-ID `<ntf_…@domain>`); secrets purged.

states.label: failed
states.detail: Retries exhausted or permanent error (`last_error`); secrets purged.

states.label: cancelled
states.detail: Customer erased before sending (recipient becomes erased@erased.invalid).
